protocol.time_step: dt = T0 / (2 L/h): 32, 64 and 128 steps per period at L/h = 16, 32, 64 (time step refined with the mesh)
protocol.note: The three runs form one refinement study. Definitions and the reference solution are in README.md.

criteria.definition: |omega - omega_ref| / omega_ref. omega is fitted to the free-surface elevation history at the left-wall probe (x = 0) with eta(t) = c + exp(-gamma t) (a cos(omega t) + b sin(omega t)) over all outputs; omega_ref = Im(s) of the linear viscous standing wave with free-slip walls (README.md).
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(L/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M1 working criterion: frequency error <= 1% at the finest mesh with observed convergence. 'Observed convergence' is read as a strictly decreasing error with an observed order of at least 1, the reading used for M2 in static_drop_2d; the expected order is 2.

criteria.definition: |gamma - gamma_ref| / gamma_ref, gamma from the same fit and gamma_ref = -Re(s) of the linear viscous standing wave (README.md). The Lamb estimate 2 nu k^2 is reported beside it.
criteria.source: Reported only. The tracker (section 5, M1) asks for a comparison of the damping with linear theory but sets no limit.

criteria.definition: max over all outputs of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0), A the exact area of {phi_h < 0} and A(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M1 working criterion: volume drift <= 1e-4 over the run
